# CRT-632 — FX_SPOT Adaptive widgets (Smart Checklist draft)

XRay / folder hint: align with Epic CRT-632 verification focus.

## Primary verification focus

- [CRT-632] Adaptive FX_SPOT: Search (rules, OPOL/currency/type filters, FX Spot tab, All tab, cards to Instrument), Recently Viewed after visit, Watchlist cards to Instrument, Instrument page (midpoint chart, Info, CFD-like Stats without maturity; other widgets no data).

## Search — rules and results

- [DXINV-174] FX_SPOT instruments are discoverable via Search using the same minimum-input and display rules as other types (symbol/description criteria per requirement).
> Figma Search: https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1768-14179

## Search — rules and results

- [DXINV-CB-206] Search supports descriptions with whitespace; results only include FX_SPOT instruments fully tradable on user balances; each result card exposes description datapoints per requirement.

## Search — filters

### OPOL, currency, instrument type

- [DXINV-CB-29] OPOL (Exchange) filter is available on Search and constrains FX_SPOT results to selected OPOL values.

## Search — filters

### OPOL, currency, instrument type

- [DXINV-CB-34] Currency filter is available on Search and constrains FX_SPOT results to selected currencies (verify Confluence key DXINV-CB-34; Jira URL once pointed at DXINV-CB-29).
> Jira hygiene: requirement link label DXINV-CB-34 vs href path DXINV-CB-29 — trace to correct spec.

## Search — filters

### OPOL, currency, instrument type

- [DXINV-CB-27] Instrument type filter supports FX_SPOT; with All tab selected, FX_SPOT instruments appear in combined results.

## Search — filters

### FX Spot tab

- [DXINV-CB-308] Instrument type filter exposes an FX Spot tab; user can search FX_SPOT specifically from that tab.

## Search — result card

- [DXINV-CB-25] FX_SPOT search result card matches required fields/behaviour and opens the Instrument page on tap.
> Figma Search: https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1768-14179

## Search — result card

- [DXINV-CB-315] FX_SPOT search result card shows OPOL/market-state parameters per requirement (including FX_Spot notes in the requirement table).

## Recently Viewed

- [DXINV-CB-4] After viewing an FX_SPOT Instrument page, the instrument appears in Recently Viewed when returning to Search.
> Ref snippet (DXINV-CB-4): recently viewed instruments list on the Search page (see DXINV-042 link target in full spec).

## Watchlist

- [DXINV-CB-91] Watchlist shows an FX_SPOT instrument card and navigates to the Instrument page on tap.
> Ref snippet (DXINV-CB-91): each instrument as a card with parameter table (full Watchlist page).
> Figma Watchlist: https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1761-40258

## Instrument page — layout

- [CRT-632] FX_SPOT Instrument page loads with Simple Chart, Instrument Info, and Stats visible; other widgets show no meaningful data in this epic.
> Figma Instrument: https://www.figma.com/design/pcmlBBNbiNL2qhCvbwQSgT/Corner?node-id=1761-107073

## Instrument page — Instrument Info

- [CRT-632] Instrument Info for FX_SPOT matches the design and parity expectations for other instrument types (header, symbol, type, currency, market state; no trading-conditions block where epic excludes it).
> Design-backed; cross-check Figma Instrument frame.

## Instrument page — Simple Chart

- [DXINV-285] Simple Chart for FX_SPOT is driven by midpoint prices (not bid) per Jira AC.
> Ref snippet (DXINV-285): chart visualization options + price type matrix pointer CRT-1180; pair with Jira AC (FX_SPOT midpoint vs bid for other types).

## Instrument page — Stats

- [DXINV-CB-309] Stats widget for FX_SPOT follows CFD-like rows and omits Maturity date as required for this type.
> Ref snippet (DXINV-CB-309): FX_SPOT metrics Multiplier / Previous close / Open / Day range (DXINV-DP-114, DP-118, DP-076, DP-119); omit Maturity per epic vs CFD template.

## Explicitly out of scope (consolidated)

- Bid-based Simple Chart for CFD, CFD*FOREX, CFD*STOCK (Hong Kong) per DXINV-285 — Epic primary scope is FX_SPOT; non-FX_SPOT branches are contrast only in Jira, not peer test threads.
- Corner Trader dxTrade5 / WebBroker configuration and desktop flows — client_shell_impact.corner_trader not_applicable; Adaptive-only epic.
- Full functional depth for Portfolio, Transactions, News, Events widgets on Instrument page — Jira states other widgets display no data and will be elaborated in other epics — limit to empty/no-data expectations here.
